title: Theranos died in 2018. Who JUST renewed its Patents... and WHY?
description:
Previously on As the Lab Turns: Theranos died in 2018. Its patent never got the memo.

IN THIS EPISODE: a 19-year-old with a health monitor you swallow. A bird flu plan nobody ran past the chickens. And a "Health Shield" with a familiar-sounding quarantine written 10 years BEFORE Covid.

Then, years after the funeral, somebody pays Theranos' patent bills.

Who? And why?

THE PRINTED ISSUE
SIDE EYE: The Loser's Issue (Issue 1) is in print. Includes pages. None require a finger prick.
Get it on Amazon: https://a.co/d/02FwgFhM (or search "side eye magazine")

CHAPTERS
0:00 The Patent Has a Pulse
0:18 Nineteen, Swallowable, Now With Chickens
1:12 Pawn Shop, Patent Edition
1:42 Set It and Forget It

ONE QUESTION FOR THE COMMENTS
What should the unsigned card on Health Shield's renewal payment say? Rule: write it as a soap opera secret admirer. No names, because the record doesn't have one.

THE FILES WE KEPT
- US 8,862,448 (Health Shield), granted Oct 2014, plus its paid-up sisters 9,460,263; 11,139,084; 11,158,429; 11,195,624
- USPTO assignment records: Theranos IP Company, pledged to Fortress Credit Corp. (Dec 2017), renamed Labrador Diagnostics (March 2020)
- USPTO maintenance-fee record: Health Shield's 12th-year fee, paid April 1, 2026
- Labrador Diagnostics LLC v. BioFire Diagnostics (D. Del. 1:20-cv-00348), asserting US 8,283,155 and 10,533,994
- Labrador's March 16, 2020 press release: "an entity owned by investment funds managed by Fortress"
